goals.text: release-tag names every commit of the package that ships without a bullet in the reviewed notes.

outcomes.change: release-tag reads the Drafted-From trailer from the release branch's commits before falling back to the parent
outcomes.checked_by: a test that merges main into the release branch, adds a notes edit, merges the release and runs the step, which must name the late commit and the drafted commit; the existing merge, squash and no-trailer tests still pass

problems.text: When the release branch takes an "Update branch" merge from main before a later commit, release-tag reads the update merge as the drafted commit and names none of the commits that landed after the notes were drafted.
